_comment: Filled in from the interview (references/interview.md). Every field the designer did not answer stays null or empty; scaffold.py turns those into visible [[ASK: ...]] markers instead of guessing.

roles.designer: Everything design, and the client relationship.

stages.name: Brief intake
stages.done_when: Lead confirms classification, scope and timeline back to the requester.

stages.name: Discovery research
stages.done_when: Every insight cites a data-collection source.

stages.name: Mental model + IA
stages.done_when: Sitemap and intent paths approved at the lead gate.

stages.name: Delivery + handoff
stages.done_when: Ship row written with the approval round it shipped from.
